reviews.classification: historical synthesis, actual mechanisms and later authority reconciliation
reviews.disposition: The five-lane audit and ten example scenarios are historical design review, not a current delegation request or a new selection. Preserve immediate powerful premises, long quiet mastery, independent world purposes, authored AU differences and real recipient/carrier/custody distinctions. A feasible route witness differs from a syntactically valid generator, and final distribution can differ from a biased rejection process. The old typed-start/apprentice/kin source observations identify that pass’s checked seams, not present whole-repository absence of dynamic definitions or recipient support. Its recommended precompiled variant is an optional route; a recording artifact still needs a real recording consumer. Current AD51 permits the first useful shared seam when its consumer warrants it, with another genuinely different case validating/revising it rather than granting permission to start. All five linked leaves retain their own review scope.

reviews.classification: historical synthesis, actual mechanisms and later authority reconciliation
reviews.disposition: Preserve the actual distinction among altered feeling, belief, attention, memory, goal, motor control and allegiance. Duration of an operation differs from the lifetime of its consequences. A private causal receipt is not automatically the target’s memory, awareness, attribution or proof, and release need not expose a source or undo spent resources and past actions. A power that genuinely changes affection can do so; a signature-only compulsion supplies no such feeling by implication. Strength remains task-specific and can dominate without a mandatory detection/counter/backlash tax. The same-ID stacking, expiry, knowledge replacement and 32-memory-tail observations are dated inspected source spans, not a renewed current code audit or universal retention policy. The six gatekeeper profiles remain alternatives; no universal architecture, current worker reservation, paused-world resumption or active build follows from this historical coordinator index.

ids: L1–L5; D1–D7; M1–M5; practical authoring loop
reviews.classification: historical synthesis, actual mechanisms and later authority reconciliation
reviews.disposition: The library remains a palette of actual rule-changing functions, with independent output/information/autonomy/portability/authority/growth axes and optional fun rankings. Free, costless, absolute and immediately strong powers remain legitimate premises; costs, counters, dormant starts and patrons are not imposed by taxonomy. Future-life creation separates existing product, recognized recipient, survival carrier, delivery and readiness; keeping a record does not deliver a soul or person. Saved generated identity differs from genuinely noisy repeated experiments. Structured validation does not provision actors/stock, sample a start or bind every arbitrary operation. Preserve original AU/canon/fanwork/crossover boundaries and the useful authoring loop without treating catalogue breadth as executable multiverse coverage. The ten reports and five audit leaves are routes to their owners, not transitive body-review credit. The suggested second case tests and refines a first shared seam under AD51, rather than a compulsory prerequisite to making one useful shared consumer.

reviews.classification: historical synthesis, actual mechanisms and later authority reconciliation
reviews.disposition: Keep the six-axis lattice and route-specific enumerated/defined/executable/playable/verified distinctions. Definition validity, useful natural acquisition, actual output consumer and durable pending/completed state prove different claims. Pairwise joins do not prove critical multi-axis ordering; include collisions actually relevant to a selected route without converting dormant ideas into required gates. Source transfer, prediction and resurrection need their real operations; descriptions or restored HP cannot substitute. Refine U3 by current AD51: implement a useful shared seam for its first genuine consumer when warranted; a second actual use validates or revises shared semantics, not permission to begin. S1–S3 are optional staged proposals, not today’s dispatch. Their recording artifact can require a new contract, and a stored capsule does not prove later delivery. The one-realm/one-prestige milestone sentence was superseded October 24. The 1366×768 target is historical; selected new UI needs the current named desktop/laptop viewport and rebuilt proof. No present random-stream, generated-definition, save or continuity behavior is reverified by this document read.
